upstream.locator: Fig.1 activity and Fig.2 total desorption heat; reviewed .15 join nodes
_W_NODES, _Q_NODES and the actual represented _m/_q curves and latent reference

domain.representation: temperature endpoints and source W nodes are the existing binary64 values; exact rational W input is retained without projection

construction.basis: excess h,s,f per kg dry matter; partial quantities and Gamma already per mol condensed water; only condensed water enters W
construction.upper_branch: exact integration and interpolation of the same represented m0/q0 nodes as the wet model; no refitting or additional observed nodes
construction.zero_inventory: xlogx(0)=0; h0=hj-bj*Wj; s0=sj-cj*Wj-(R/M)*Wj; f0=h0-T*s0; aw=0; mu and Gamma have explicit infinite-limit labels and null values
construction.reference: preserve generally nonzero h0/s0; no global reference shift, no formation-enthalpy claim and no permission to discard the dry endpoint excess
construction.gamma_join: distinct left R*T/Wj and right represented-source derivative; not a smooth join

assumptions: Below .15 hold q0 equal to the .15 heat node; this is not a measured low-moisture heat curve
Ideal-dilution activity shape below .15, no adsorption/desorption hysteresis, and no nucleation barrier
Temperature-independent excess h/s and zero excess volume; unknown temperature and pressure extension errors
Fixed dry mass and existing water reference; reaction or dry-mass change requires a separate reference audit

held_out.locator: same Arlabosse2005 Fig.1 curve, source facts observation; Fig.2 heat remains unknown
held_out.scope: same-curve holdout can constrain near-join shape; shared calibration and no low-W multi-temperature evidence

numerical_policy.h: exact rational algebra of represented source nodes and exact input W
numerical_policy.s_f: exact rational algebra on upper branch and analytical zero; on positive lower branch exact algebra conditional on the nominal math.log/log1p result
numerical_policy.gas_constant: one actual molar R and mass M; molar logarithm term is R*T*log(W/Wj); no second rounded specific-R constant
numerical_policy.readout_difference: old wet interpolation/integration and Rs=R/M were rounded in binary64; exact represented-node arithmetic may differ by small roundoff, not evidence of changed source measurements
numerical_policy.logarithm: log1p near join, log of positive represented W away from join; numerical log error is unquantified
numerical_policy.positive_nonrepresentable: reject overflow or nonzero-to-zero float projection; never silently classify positive W as dry
numerical_policy.identity: nominal f=h-T*s is exact algebra, not a certified bound on transcendental or physical model error
